Founded and led by Creative Director Courtney Giles, Studio Smiths takes on a considered number of projects each year, giving every space the attention it deserves. Our work is warm, textural and precise. We design from the inside out, starting with how a space needs to function and shaping it with a calm, cohesive aesthetic that lasts.
